CVM open data (Brazil): DFP annual statements 2023-2025 and the FCA securities list 2026, trimmed to five companies
(Petrobras 009512, Vale 004170, WEG 005410, Ambev 023264, Embraer 020087). Recorded 2026-11-10 from
https://dados.cvm.gov.br/dados/CIA_ABERTA/DOC/DFP/DADOS/ and .../FCA/DADOS/, decoded from Latin-1 to UTF-8, rows kept
as published.

Contains information from the CVM Open Data Portal (https://dados.cvm.gov.br/), made available under the Open
Database License (ODbL, https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). These files are a derived database and are
offered under the same licence.
